providers/agentfund.toml.instructions_text: AgentFund pay-per-call US public data and deterministic text utilities, settled in USDC on Base; prices run $0.001-$0.03 per call and failed upstream calls are never charged. Every tool is POST with a flat JSON body. Three data groups: US macro (treasury_yield_curve with computed 2s10s/3m10y spreads, bls_cpi, macro_jobs, macro_pce, macro_gdp, macro_retail_sales, macro_housing, macro_energy, macro_release_calendar), SEC EDGAR (edgar_insider_transactions Form 4, edgar_financials XBRL, edgar_13f_holdings, edgar_filings_feed, edgar_full_text_search), and on-chain EVM reads (onchain_token_balances, onchain_portfolio, onchain_cross_chain_balances, onchain_oracle_price, onchain_gas; chain = base | ethereum | optimism | arbitrum | polygon). Plus structured_json_repair and tabular_to_json for messy LLM/tool output (CSV/TSV/Markdown). Sources are free public-domain US government data or direct RPC reads, so figures carry each source's publication lag and revision policy.
providers/agentfund.toml.name: AgentFund US Economic, SEC & On-Chain Data

providers/arkham.toml.instructions_text: Arkham wallet intelligence: pre-trade due diligence, counterparty and smart-money analysis, balances, portfolios, flows, token/market data, and Polymarket activity. All routes are POST with JSON body fields (path parameters become body fields; EVM addresses are lowercased). $0.20 per credit; per-row endpoints (transfers, swaps) price from `limit` — pass the smallest useful limit. Rate limits: 100 req/s per wallet on most endpoints, 5 req/s on heavy ones (transfers, swaps, token/top, counterparties, flow, search). Failed upstream requests are not charged.
providers/arkham.toml.name: Arkham Intel (x402)

providers/brazilayer.toml.instructions_text: Official Brazilian registry and market data: Receita Federal CNPJ registry, CVM fund disclosures, BACEN authorizations, PNCP tenders, sanctions lists, EUDR deforestation, commodity/macros feeds. Response keys use Portuguese legal terms (razao_social, situacao_cadastral, ...). Paid calls settle x402 USDC on Base; each tool states its price ($0.001–$0.10 per call). Validate a CNPJ free with brazilayer_ferramentas_cnpj__valor_ before any paid lookup — an invalid CNPJ never resolves anywhere. The twelve *_amostra tools are free shape samples of each dataset. brazilayer_cnpj_busca and brazilayer_cnpj_socio__busca require at least one filter; result totals cap at the string "10000+". brazilayer_pacotes__brasil bundles the 13 parameter-free endpoints in one call for $0.09.
providers/brazilayer.toml.name: Brazilayer — Brazilian Company Data (CNPJ)

brazilayer_bcb_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the Central Bank check response

brazilayer_cadeias_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of a full causal chain

brazilayer_cnpj_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free full sample (format of /v1/empresa/{cnpj}/completo) for one fixed CNPJ

params.nome: Full-text on legal and trade names (Portuguese, accent-insensitive). Example: padaria.
Person or entity name (full-text, accent-insensitive); at least 3 characters.

brazilayer_commodities_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the commodity signals dataset

brazilayer_desmatamento_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the deforestation dataset

brazilayer_empresa_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the enriched profile (a sanctioned company with public contracts)

brazilayer_ferramentas.description: Free — no payment required. Free tools index — no payment, no limit, no signup

brazilayer_ferramentas_cnpj_valor.description: Free — no payment required. Check digits, normalized 14-digit form, punctuated form, 8-digit root (economic group) and headquarters/branch flag. Pure arithmetic — no database lookup. Use it before paying: an invalid CNPJ never resolves in any paid endpoint.

brazilayer_ferramentas_cpf_valor.description: Free — no payment required. Check-digit validation only. Pure arithmetic: nothing is stored or looked up, and the response never echoes the full number — only the masked form.

brazilayer_fundos_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the fund industry dataset

brazilayer_health.description: Free — no payment required. Service status and data reference month (free)

brazilayer_integridade_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample screening response (real sanctioned company)

brazilayer_integridade_consulta_cnpj.description:
Screens a Brazilian company against CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, the slave-labor
blacklist (MTE) and leniency agreements. Legal-entity records only.
Sources updated daily. Price: $0.01 per call (vendor summary).

brazilayer_licitacoes_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the supplier-contracts response

brazilayer_mercado_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the markets dataset (news + indicators)

brazilayer_pacotes_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free list of the packs, what each contains and what it saves

brazilayer_tributos_amostra.description: Free — no payment required. Free sample of the tax reform dataset

providers/concordance/provider.toml.instructions_text: Concordance aggregates 18 refreshed-on-schedule data sources (SEC EDGAR, FRED, World Bank, UN Comtrade, GDELT news, CourtListener, govinfo, arXiv/CORE, Hacker News, Stack Exchange, Wikipedia, weather, DefiLlama, finnhub/twelvedata/polygon quotes) into six paid tools, $0.01-$0.05 per call in USDC (Base or Solana). Every tool takes a flat JSON body; responses cite real sources, never black-box summaries. concordance_search: one-query full-text search with optional source/category/since filters. concordance_digest: one call groups a topic across every category with counts (not an LLM summary). concordance_timeline: coverage ordered oldest-first for tracking a story. concordance_corroboration: counts DISTINCT sources backing a claim - the trust signal. concordance_company_brief: quotes from 3 market providers + SEC filings + mentions for one ticker or company name; partial sections are normal. concordance_series: tabular series by source + series_id (fred GDP/CPIAUCSL/UNRATE/FEDFUNDS/DGS10; world_bank US-<indicator>). Call concordance_help for the vendor's full document.
providers/concordance/provider.toml.name: Concordance

params.company: Ticker (AAPL) or company name (Apple). Coverage is a bounded vendor watchlist.

concordance_search.description: Full-text search across every aggregated data source in one call: news, SEC filings, court opinions, academic papers, government records, and developer discussions. One query surfaces everything concordant across independently-sourced, citable results (source, category, title, content, url, published_at) -- not a single-source wrapper. Optional source/category/since filters; limit 1-100 (default 20). $0.01 per call.

concordance_series.description: Tabular time-series lookup by source + series_id: economic indicators (FRED, World Bank, UN Comtrade), crypto TVL (DefiLlama), weather (open_meteo), and stock quotes (finnhub/twelvedata/polygon). Optional start/end date range; returns [{observed_at, value}] points. $0.01 per call. Source slugs and series ids are listed in the param notes; the vendor's free /catalog endpoint has the live list.

params.series_id: Vendor series id, e.g. fred: GDP, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE, FEDFUNDS, DGS10; world_bank: US-NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (<COUNTRY>-<indicator>). The vendor's free /catalog endpoint lists every live series.
params.source: Catalog source slug: arxiv, core, courtlistener, defillama, finnhub, gdelt, govinfo, hackernews, open_meteo, polygon, regulations_gov, sec_edgar, stackexchange, twelvedata, un_comtrade, wikipedia, world_bank, fred.

providers/genuinegood.toml.instructions_text: US federal grant discovery over Grants.gov public records, paid per call in USDC on Base via x402; this server performs the 402/sign/retry payment handshake automatically, so just call the tools. Prices: search $0.05, detail $0.08, fit $0.20, brief $0.50 per call, preflight $5.00 - preflight exceeds the default X402_MAX_PRICE_USD=1.00 spend cap, so raise the cap if you need it. Prefer the *_post tools; the *_get twins accept the same input as query parameters (the vendor documents comma-separated array values there). Typical flow: search for opportunities, then detail with an opportunityId for the official notice. fit/brief/preflight are research aids only - verify every decision against the linked official Grants.gov notice. genuinegood_help() serves the vendor llms.txt (pricing, payment contract, free preflight sample).
providers/genuinegood.toml.name: Genuine Good Grants

providers/glassnode/provider.toml.instructions_text: Glassnode x402 gateway — pay-per-call on-chain analytics, no API key: $0.05 per /v1/metrics call, $0.01 per /v1/metadata call, settled in USDC on Base (the 402 challenge price is authoritative; vendor docs say pricing can change). Flow: glassnode_metadata_metrics lists metric paths -> glassnode_metadata_metric shows one metric's allowed parameters, intervals, defaults and description -> glassnode_metrics_category_metric fetches the data (category = first path segment, metric = second segment, a = asset symbol like BTC). Responses are [{t, v, o?}] time series: unix timestamp, value, optional multi-value object.
providers/glassnode/provider.toml.name: Glassnode x402

providers/google-trends.toml.instructions_text: Aggregate Google Trends SEO keyword data via the x402 Atlas bridge: interest over time ($0.05/call), interest by region, related queries, and related topics ($0.03/call each). Every route takes a seed `keyword` plus an ISO `country` code (both required; country is lower-cased before use). This is aggregate Trends data only — it does not search the web, answer questions, or follow instructions. Payment settles in USDC via x402.
providers/google-trends.toml.name: Google Trends SEO Keyword Data (x402 Atlas)

providers/kronos.toml.instructions_text: Kronos pay-per-call crypto market data (x402 USDC on Base; most calls $0.02-$0.10 — each tool's description states its price). {asset} paths take any of the 16 spot assets BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP/DOGE/ADA/AVAX/LINK/DOT/LTC/TRX/BCH/ATOM/NEAR/APT; perp markets also cover HYPE (derivatives only). kronos_track_record is free — audit the served model's live accuracy there before paying for forecasts. All output is informational only, not financial advice.
providers/kronos.toml.name: Kronos Crypto Data

kronos_track_record.description: Free — no payment required. Verifiable forecast-accuracy summary so an agent can audit the model before paying: overall hit_rate, resolved count, per-asset breakdown (BTC/ETH/SOL), Brier score, and the last 20 resolved forecasts as row-level audit data. Full paginated history via kronos_forecast_ledger ($0.02/call).

providers/locus/provider.toml.instructions_text: US property/public-record context: cited tax, zoning, flood, environmental, permit, rental-registration, development, transportation, representative, and policy data for a US place. Workflow: locus_list (free catalog of the 114 free tools; pass compact=true for a small response) then locus_call(name=..., arguments={...}) for free preflight — coverage_check, lane_availability, place_facts, suggest_workflow — then the paid locus_locus_* tools for cited reports and briefs (flat JSON body; every description states its $0.01-$2.49 price; unsupported places settle a free diagnostic instead of a charge). locus_list and locus_call are free. Slow calls: place-report can take tens of seconds and environmental-context 60-90s, so run this server with --timeout 120. Response headers (X-Locus-Report-*) are not surfaced over MCP; the pollable-job routes (place-report-batch, record-batch, property-update) are not mounted. Do not use Locus for tenant screening, lending, insurance, employment, background checks, appraisal, valuation, policing, or safe/unsafe labels.
providers/locus/provider.toml.name: Locus — US property & public-records context

providers/lonestar.toml.instructions_text: LoneStarOracle: 71 independent pay-per-call data services behind one catalog — macro/labor/energy, equities and smart-money flow, crypto due diligence, geopolitical/compliance risk, and contract audits. The unified spec's root server is the /api gateway, which proxies every service payment-gated (each op also names its canonical <service>.lonestaroracle.xyz host via x-direct-url). Tier markers: ops with authMode=free answer ungated (their descriptions say so); payment ops settle per call via x402 USDC on Base, $0.001-$2.00 per call, with the price in each description. Rate limit: 30 requests per 60 seconds shared across every route. Audit routes (rattler/cottonmouth/copperhead) can take minutes — raise --timeout. Demos, previews, per-service /feed pages, and subscription-management routes are deliberately not exposed.
providers/lonestar.toml.name: LoneStarOracle

providers/otto.toml.instructions_text: Otto AI's autonomous agent swarm sells pay-per-call services, settled in USDC on Base on every endpoint (some paths also quote Solana; the live 402's accepts[] is authoritative — Permit2/upto needs a one-time USDC allowance). Capability tags: Market & Token Intelligence (news + recaps, KOL sentiment, token analysis/price/fundamentals/security/score, trending, top holders, tokenized-stock movers), DeFi & Markets Data (TVL/yields, stablecoin peg-watch, market-risk composite, protocol revenue, DEX pool search + one-hour Uniswap APR, Polymarket odds, funding rates, TradFi macro, SEC Form 4/13F + equity smart-money), Web & Domain Intelligence (DNS, WHOIS, domain age/report, web-search/answer/extract/links/json-extract), Real-World Data (FX rates, weather), AI Creative & Tools (image/video generation, llm-research, tx-explainer), Portfolio & Accounts (wallet and position reads for the paying address), plus meta-intelligence (router ranks the best x402 services for a task, $0.001) and feedback (money-back guarantee; needs the original payment tx hash from X-Payment-Receipt). Fund-moving routes (swap, bridge, deposit, withdraw) and the full-auto spending router are deliberately NOT exposed by this server. Published prices are per call from $0.001; a route's live challenge outranks any published table, and every settled call returns a signed receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
providers/otto.toml.name: Otto AI x402 — Market Intelligence, DeFi & Trading

pdl_company_enrich.description: People Data Labs company enrichment. $0.10 per match, free on no match. Returns firmographics, industry codes, funding, social profiles. Provide at least one identifier: pdl_id (or LinkedIn slug), name, website domain, ticker, profile URL, or HQ location.

params.min_likelihood: Minimum confidence score 1-10 (default 2). Higher = fewer, better matches.

pdl_company_search.description: Search 30M+ People Data Labs company records via Elasticsearch DSL or SQL. $0.10 x size (max $10); free when the result set is empty. Paginate with the returned scroll_token.

params.size: Batch size 1-100 (default 1). Price scales with size.

pdl_person_enrich.description: People Data Labs person enrichment. $0.28 per match, free on no match. Returns demographics, work history, education, contact info, social profiles, skills. Provide at least one identifier: pdl_id, email, phone, profile URL (e.g. LinkedIn), name parts, or company/school + location.

params.min_likelihood: Minimum confidence score 1-10 (default 2). Higher = fewer, better matches.

pdl_person_search.description: Search 3B+ People Data Labs person records via Elasticsearch DSL or SQL. $0.28 x size (max $28); free when the result set is empty. Recommended size 1-5. Paginate with the returned scroll_token. dataset picks record sources (resume, email, phone, mobile_phone, street_address, consumer_social, developer, all).

params.size: Batch size 1-100 (default 1). Price scales with size.

providers/regimeshift.toml.instructions_text: RegimeShift on Base mainnet: Agent-SOFR USD short-rate benchmark, variance-aware max-LTV, and ETH/BTC volatility risk premium at $0.001/call each (x402 USDC), plus a free on-chain RFQ clearinghouse. Typical flow: read regimeshift_rate_sofr_usd and regimeshift_risk_max_ltv, POST a lend/borrow intent (free), then long-poll regimeshift_intent_intent_id_match (run this server with --timeout 320 so the up-to-300s poll survives) or watch the intents/matches endpoints; matched quotes carry EIP-712 payloads ready for on-chain originate() via InterAgentRepoV4.
providers/regimeshift.toml.name: RegimeShift

regimeshift_active_loans.description: Free — no payment required. All currently-active loans with their current Chainlink-priced LTV, liquidatable or not — useful for lender position monitoring.

regimeshift_intent_borrow.description: Free — no payment required. Submit a borrower intent (wallet, USDC principal wanted vs WETH collateral, max rate, max duration); matching runs synchronously and returns a match payload when a compatible lender is found.

regimeshift_intent_intent_id_match.description: Free — no payment required. Long-poll for a match on an open intent: holds the connection up to wait seconds (max 300) and returns immediately when a match is found, otherwise a timeout packet — re-poll on timeout. Run this server with --timeout 320 so the long poll survives. stream=true (newline-delimited JSON) is not usable through MCP — leave it false.

params.stream: Ignore — ndjson streaming is not usable through MCP; leave false.
params.wait: Seconds to hold the connection waiting for a match (up to 300).

regimeshift_intent_intent_id_matches.description: Free — no payment required. All matches for an intent plus its fill status (the sweep view): every match behind a partially-filled lender intent, each with the full signed quote payload, plus filled vs remaining capacity.

regimeshift_intent_lend.description: Free — no payment required. Submit a lender intent to the order book (wallet, USDC amount, min rate, max duration); matching runs synchronously on each new intent and a matched quote payload becomes available via regimeshift_matches_recent.

regimeshift_intents_open.description: Free — no payment required. All currently-open intents from both sides — the live order book. Matching requires overlap on duration first (borrower's needed term ≤ lender's max), then rate, then amount + collateral fit.

regimeshift_liquidatable_loans.description: Free — no payment required. Active loans with on-chain LTV ≥ 95% whose grace period has passed — anyone can call InterAgentRepoV4.liquidate(loanId) for the 3% bounty. Read-only; does not execute liquidations.

regimeshift_loans_registry.description: Free — no payment required. Full lifecycle of every V4 loan reconstructed from on-chain event logs: the last limit originated loans (~14h lookback, 30s cache) with status, counterparties, principal/collateral, rate, LTV and originate/close tx hashes.

regimeshift_matches_recent.description: Free — no payment required. Recent matches with full signed-quote payloads (EIP-712 signature, rate decomposition, contract address) ready for on-chain originate().

providers/socialfetch.toml.instructions_text: SocialFetch social and web data via x402 USDC on Base. Select platforms using OpenAPI tags (for example Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn). Prices are quoted in credits, approximately $0.014 USDC per credit; follow each tool description for base costs and usage-dependent surcharges. The payment challenge is authoritative. LinkedIn includes both API versions: tools with socialfetch_linkedin_ use v1, and socialfetch_v2_linkedin_ use v2. Parameter names and HTTP paths preserve their original casing. Slow transcript/search requests may need a 90-second timeout.
providers/socialfetch.toml.name: SocialFetch

providers/straits/provider.toml.instructions_text: Straits.live monitors the Strait of Hormuz crisis: the free tier (tags: Free) carries summary counts, short windows, and hand-curated indicators with no payment; the premium tier (tags: Premium) adds the live-AIS per-vessel manifest, single-vessel OFAC+UK sanctions dossiers, a shadow-fleet risk screen, full-resolution history, bulk export, bunker prices, and a modeled war-risk premium, settled per request in USDC on Base via x402 ($0.01-$0.25 per call, no key, no account). Rate limit: 30 requests per 60 seconds shared across every route - prefer straits_snapshot or straits_index over polling many series. Feed enum for straits_history_feed: index-5min, transits, stranded, ais-gaps (days 1-30 applies to index-5min only). straits_vessel_imo takes a 7-digit IMO number; straits_export bundles series (feeds subset, json|csv). Every settled call returns a signed x402 receipt; the vendor's llms.txt (straits_help()) carries the free-vs-premium comparison.
providers/straits/provider.toml.name: Straits.live Hormuz monitor

straits_ais_gaps.description: Free — no payment required. Count of tankers that were broadcasting in the chokepoint core and went silent for 3-24 hours, plus the 7-day baseline. Computed every 30 minutes. Per-vessel dark-fleet identities are premium data.

straits_briefs.description: Free — no payment required. JSON archive of every daily brief: 3-6 bullets, a short summary, the day's Brent price plus 24-hour delta, and the day's transit count, keyed by UTC date. Rewritten every few hours.

straits_carriers.description: Free — no payment required. Top container carriers by TEU capacity and their Hormuz posture (suspended, rerouting, limited, transiting), vessels-trapped count, trapped TEU, and per-carrier surcharge in USD per TEU. hormuzPosture is the operative field: 5+ carriers stopped within 60-day advisories drives the 'effectively closed' verdict. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

straits_chokepoints.description: Free — no payment required. Side-by-side daily counts for Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Suez, the Cape of Good Hope, and Malacca (IMF PortWatch), sorted Hormuz first then by nTotal descending.

straits_cushing.description: Free — no payment required. Cushing, Oklahoma WTI-delivery-hub inventories from the EIA weekly report - tracks the North-American crude balance independently of the Gulf-Coast / SPR picture; pairs with the Brent-WTI spread. Re-fetched daily 11:30 ET.

straits_events.description: Free — no payment required. Indexed strikes, ship incidents, closures, and negotiations with source attribution - GDELT auto-pull every 15 minutes plus hand-curated events.

straits_gas.description: Free — no payment required. Per-state regular-grade averages plus a national mean across the 50 states plus DC (AAA). Refreshed hourly; upstream publishes daily.

straits_index.description: Free — no payment required. The two 0-100 Hormuz Index composites - Crisis Pressure (current state) and Escalation Forecast (30-day outlook) - with bands and per-component breakdowns. Recomputed every 5 minutes.

straits_insurance.description: Free — no payment required. Multiple over the peace-baseline VLCC premium, per-voyage cost in USD from peacetime baseline to current crisis high, and the P&I clubs / war-risk underwriters that have withdrawn cover, imposed quotas, or refused renewals. Hand-curated; timestamp refreshed weekly.

straits_iran_rate.description: Free — no payment required. Open-market USD/IRR sell/buy rates in Toman (1 Toman = 10 Rial) and Rial, plus 24-hour and 7-day percentage deltas off the midRial - a proxy for civilian-side financial stress inside Iran. Refreshed hourly.

straits_jwc.description: Free — no payment required. Marine war-risk high-risk areas from the Lloyd's Joint War Committee circular, plus a flag for whether the latest revision mentions the Arabian Gulf. Drives war-risk premium loads at most London-market underwriters. Re-checked every 6 hours.

straits_markets.description: Free — no payment required. Top Hormuz / Iran-conflict / oil-shock contracts from Kalshi and Polymarket, strict keyword-filtered. Underlying feed every 15 minutes.

straits_oil.description: Free — no payment required. Rolling Brent and WTI prices from intraday front-month futures contracts (Yahoo Finance chart data, continuous quotes as fallback, EIA daily backstop). Underlying feed every 10 minutes; not edge-cached.

straits_pipelines.description: Free — no payment required. Petroline (Saudi Arabia to Yanbu) and Habshan-Fujairah (UAE to Gulf of Oman) - the main crude routes out of the Gulf without transiting Hormuz - with nameplate capacity in BPD and current utilisation. Hand-curated.

straits_ports.description: Free — no payment required. Live vessel counts at Fujairah, Sohar, Bandar Abbas, and Jebel Ali from AIS positions inside a 10-18 km radius per port, by status (anchored, transiting) and vessel type. Computed every 30 minutes.

straits_sanctioned_vessels.description: Free — no payment required. Count of vessels visible on AIS in the Persian Gulf window whose identity matches an OFAC SDN entry (IMO / normalised-name join; false positives possible). Cross-join every 15 minutes; per-vessel detail is premium data.

straits_since.description: Free — no payment required. Compares current state to a caller-provided anchor timestamp and raises a material flag once any of: 24h+ elapsed, Brent moved 1%+, any new event, any carrier posture change, transit delta 3+, or stranded delta 5+. 60-second edge cache.

straits_spr.description: Free — no payment required. SPR stocks from the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report with the 4-week change so spike-vs-baseline reads correctly. Re-fetched daily 11:00 ET.

straits_stranded.description: Free — no payment required. Anchored-vessel count inside the Persian Gulf bounding box, hourly buckets written every 30 minutes. Powers the homepage sparkline.

straits_tick.description: Free — no payment required. Bare-minimum payload for polling: Brent price, 24-hour change, transit and stranded counts, plus a verifiedAt anchor. 30-second edge cache.

straits_trade_impact.description: Free — no payment required. EIA/IEA shares of global seaborne oil and LNG transiting the strait, a curated daily economic-cost estimate, the most-affected importing economies, and extra Cape-reroute voyage days. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

straits_transits.description: Free — no payment required. The dashboard's authoritative daily transit count with per-type breakdown (tanker, cargo, container, dry bulk, general cargo, Ro-Ro), capacity in DWT, trailing 30-day baseline median, and the fixed pre-crisis baseline (2025-02-28 to 2026-02-27). nCargo is nContainer plus nDryBulk plus nGeneralCargo plus nRoro - summing all seven fields double-counts.

straits_transits_by_type.description: Free — no payment required. Hourly cross-tab of vessels in transit by type (tanker, cargo, military, other); the military count is a floor - the response's methodology field explains how type is resolved.

providers/x402stock.toml.instructions_text: Pay-per-call market and economic data: US stocks/ETFs/options, forex, crypto and on-chain perps, energy commodities, macro (Fed, CPI, jobs, GDP, Treasury), SEC filings, congressional trades, and sentiment. Endpoints live under /api/v1 and return {ticker, data, source, as_of}. Path placeholders like {ticker} go in the URL path (uppercase symbols), never as query parameters; resolve unknown symbols first via /api/v1/tickers?search=. Unpaid requests to paid endpoints answer HTTP 402 with the quote in response headers; pay the quoted USDC amount and retry the same request.
providers/x402stock.toml.name: x402stock

providers/x402-list.toml.instructions_text: Search for Base services (network=BSE), then inspect service details. Directory listings and observed prices are leads, not payment/delivery guarantees or executable schemas. Use a documented OpenAPI URL with treazure_source_preview/add when those tools are authorized. Reads are unauthenticated but share an IP-level free quota; excess reads may require x402 payment and remain subject to the configured wallet cap. Do not assume a listing supplies an OpenAPI URL.
